sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction to the court below for early disposal of Case No. 844 of 2018 (State Vs. Vikas and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.
0434 of 2017, under Section, 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station - Kotwali, District - Pilibhit, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pilibhit.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the case has remained pending since 2018.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.

Suman Balmiki vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 16 February,
2023 
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 52 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 4346 of 2023 Applicant :- Suman Balmiki Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 5 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Shahid Ali Siddiqui Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the record.
This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction to the court below for early disposal of Case No. 844 of 2018 (State Vs. Vikas and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.
0434 of 2017, under Section, 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station - Kotwali, District - Pilibhit, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pilibhit.
Considering the fact that the case has remained pending since 2018.
